sources.title: Koushim/yolov8-license-plate-detection · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🚗 YOLOv8 License Plate Detection Model This repository contains a YOLOv8 object detection model trained to detect license plates in real-world images. The model was trained using the Ultralytics YOLOv8 framework and can be deployed for real-time applications such as surveillance, traffic monitoring, and vehicle identification.
